name: Nullfield
description: For 2 turns no enemy can use a skill: Silence 2 turns on every enemy (a boss holds it 1, as the status rules shorten its statuses); every Shield on an ally is doubled. Heavy cast.

effects.note: statuses.ts shortens a boss’s or hunter’s statuses by 1: they hold 1
every Shield on the caster’s side absorbs +percent% of what it has left
a boss or hunter gets `status` for `duration` (shortened by 1 as every boss status: 2)
